llm.summary: WAB produced a clean liftoff and positive excess return attributed to company-specific alpha. No supplied evidence isolates the underlying company mechanism or excludes an Industrials tailwind.
llm.root_cause: WAB produced a clean liftoff and positive excess return attributed to company-specific alpha. No supplied evidence isolates the underlying company mechanism or excludes an Industrials tailwind.
llm.lesson: The company-alpha book surfaced WAB, while rotation, catalyst, regime, and timing attribution remains unresolved.
llm.engines_credit: The company-alpha book is the provisional role model; no other book or organ has enough evidence to be called a role model or laggard.

causal_chain.mechanism: An unspecified idiosyncratic advantage generated relative strength.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Without the asserted company-specific advantage, sector rotation or a catalyst would need to explain the liftoff.

causal_chain.mechanism: A clean buy process participated in the favorable path without a recorded process fault.
causal_chain.counterfactual: A late or extended entry could have weakened capture, but entry-path evidence is absent.

alternate_explanations: A broad Industrials rotation may have driven part of the result.
Unreported external news may have accelerated the move.
missing_evidence: Price and volume history around entry

signal_hypotheses.measurement: Measure entry-date relative strength against both SPY and the relevant Industrials peer group.
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Dual market-relative and sector-relative strength should be associated with cleaner liftoffs.
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: Market-relative strength predicts outcomes but sector-relative strength adds no information.
